title: cotton pillow cases
text: cotton pillow cases. These are nice.. the sage is darker than I was expecting, however, I would definitely describe the color as sage - just dark sage.  They have a sateen finish... they are what I would consider as a medium weight - a little stiff, however, they washed up nicely and I expect them soften with subsequent washing and use.

product_metadata.title: Cifelli Home OrganicPro 100% Certified Organic Cotton 2 Pack Standard Pillowcase Pillowcase (2 Pack), White
features: 200 Thread Count - 100% Certified Organic Turkish Cotton Standard Pillowcase // Eco Friendly // Mesh Carrying Bag// Certifications: GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), Oeko-Tek Standard 100 - Confidence in Textiles, 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed - We pride ourselves on customer service/support, email us with any questions, comments or concerns.

Made in TURKEY: Turkish Cotton is well known as a premium and luxurious cotton. Its long staple fibers are what make it extremely durable and soft. These high-quality sheets are made where they are grown and the benefit of this is that you avoid contamination through packaging and travel of the raw cotton and possibility of it mixing with lower quality cottons. We pride ourselves in ensuring that all steps of production are fully done under our own supervision and not outsourced.

100% TRIPLE CERTIFIED ORGANIC COTTON: In addition to having Turkish Cotton sheets, you can rest easy knowing you are sleeping on organic cotton. Our sheets are fully certified in all 3 organic categories and guaranteed 100% Organic. (The raw cotton is Organic, the dyes used to color are Organic, and all production is in a concealed Organic environment.) We pride ourselves in ensuring this certification and we want you to know that you are buying a safe, ethical and premium quality sheet set.
CONTENTS AND SIZES: 2 Standard Pillowcases (21" x 31")

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold with like colors. For the benefit of the environment hang dry and use biodegradable detergent or organic detergents. If hang drying isn’t an option, tumble dry low, and remove immediately after drying is done to avoid wrinkling. Do Not Bleach. Do Not Dry Clean. (*Organic Cotton gets softer with each wash since it is not treated with any harsh chemicals* *By using biodegradable or organic detergent you are ensuring long term durability of the sheets*)
